detail.longDescription: wTF is my attempt to understand all the development that my agents are doing all the time without getting splitting headaches and standing a chance of reading a couple of pages in any given book by the end of day. It gives me an overview of what actually happened. It's also in early experimentation to see if it can help ground the agents in actual reality. Not there yet, though. Free, open source, no API, 100% local.
